items.text: Across the four clinics, does a change package of a prescribing prompt, a consult-room guide, free urine culture in October and November, owner tablet-giving support and monthly clinic feedback, tested in PDSA cycles from October 2026 to January 2027, reduce the weekly share of systemic antimicrobial prescriptions that are HPCIAs from about 27 percent to 15 percent or less?
items.population: Systemic antimicrobial prescriptions for dogs and cats in the four clinics
items.intervention: Prescribing prompt, consult-room guide, free urine culture for two months, nurse tablet-giving appointments and monthly clinic feedback
items.comparator: Twelve-week baseline extracted from the practice management system
items.outcome: Weekly HPCIA share of systemic antimicrobial prescriptions from the report builder
items.time: Twelve baseline weeks, then 16 weeks of PDSA cycles

finer: Feasible within existing reports, meetings and staff; interesting to the partners and nurses; novel only locally, which suits QI; ethical under the governance classification; relevant because the guideline is not followed.
summary: One SMART QI aim with a time-bound target and a weekly run-chart measure.
